    "Repeated, recent evidence of a specific task, musical sound, story preference, or listening mood is insufficiently distinguished from incidental interests.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, capacity, quantity, and equipment prerequisites determine whether related products are actually useful.",
    "A useful next choice must add value beyond recently acquired items; sparse or unidentified history provides weak support for specific intent."
  ],

    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users identify as immediate choices, separated from items they find merely plausible or potentially useful later.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to unsupported prerequisites, incompatibility, duplication, or mismatch with a recent repeated interest.",
    "The frequency with which users prefer a lower-ranked specific match over higher-ranked broadly related items.",
    "The share of unassessable recommendations caused by insufficient identifiable history or item information, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}
